boundary: Only already positively observed parameter-free GET contracts, current existing identity and grants. Exact compiled requests, raw response bound 1 MiB, existing projection bound 100 rows/64 KiB. Verified only for two successful meaningful untruncated positive projections that agree. Valid empty arrays may agree; opaque/withheld-only objects cannot. Previously changed audit/system counters are not retried to seek a passing snapshot. Raw returned values withheld; no independent implementation, whole endpoint or mutation claim.
